judge: none (exact-match only) -- NOT the official gpt-4o judge
why_not_run_fdb_v3_sh_directly: This is a from-scratch full-100 inference run against a live Gemini Live session per scenario; it took multiple hours end to end and needed auto-recovery (restart the agent if it dies or stalls, resume without re-running completed scenarios) that run_fdb_v3.sh's single linear script does not have. overnight_runner.py wraps the exact same run_tool_benchmark_all_released.py / evaluate_tool_calls.py / evaluate_pass_rate.py calls run_fdb_v3.sh itself would make -- same agent code, same official (unmodified) scorer, same benchmark data -- it only adds retry/resume orchestration around them. See patches/README.md for why overnight_runner.py exists.
seed: PYTHONHASHSEED as set by the shell environment at run time (not independently pinned per-invocation the way scripts/run_fdb_v3.sh's SEED=1234 is) -- not separately recorded; flagged here rather than fabricated. scripts/run_fdb_v3.sh (the actual reproduction script that gets re-run for grading) does pin PYTHONHASHSEED=1234 (see run_config.json it writes to results/{mode}/<run_id>/).
important_caveat: These are EXACT-MATCH scores (judge='none'), not the official --use-llm (gpt-4o) judge the graded re-run uses, because no OPENAI_API_KEY was available in this environment when this run was made. Argument accuracy and pass@1 under the official semantic judge will differ (typically higher, since exact-match is stricter than semantic matching). See results/OVERNIGHT_REPORT.md for the full breakdown and docs/dashboard_data.json for the curated numbers the dashboard's Results tab displays.
